parse.title: Illusionist (Chrysalis)
parse.text:
Overview

Illusionist (Chrysalis) is a MythicalMythical unit. He is only obtainable through evolution from Illusionist (Betrayal) by getting 2,000 kills with him, and attaining 37.5% awakening (via Worthy Souls or sacrificing mythic units) to evolve.

Evolving

Illusionist (Chrysalis) can evolve into Illusionist (Fusion) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Illusionist (Chrysalis)
Result
Illusionist (Fusion)

(you will need 62.5% worthiness (125 worthy souls) as well as 5000 kills in order to get Illusionist (Fusion))

  • To get Worthy Souls (each Worthy Soul has 0.5% awakening), you need to either clear Karakora Town - Act 6 (Legend Stage), or by sacrificing MythicalMythical units for 12.5% each.

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
